metrics.label: EPS growth
metrics.formula: (EPS_t − EPS_t-1) / EPS_t-1 × 100, diluted EPS; empty if prior EPS ≤ 0

metrics.label: Debt / Equity
metrics.formula: Long-term debt / Shareholders' equity (not shown for Financials)

metrics.label: Current ratio
metrics.formula: Current assets / Current liabilities (not shown for Financials)

metrics.label: P/E
metrics.formula: Price / Diluted EPS; empty if EPS ≤ 0

metrics.label: P/B
metrics.formula: Market cap / Shareholders' equity; empty if equity ≤ 0
